title: Разговор на воздухе  (A Talk Outside in the Fresh Air)

segments.t: Terrified by Nastya's sudden affectionate behavior, Kostya runs into the kitchen begging for help. Right behind him, Max appears yet again, and Senya and Fedya persuade Chef Barinov to simply step outside with Max and listen to what he has to say so he will finally leave.
Шеф, шеф, шеф, это не поможет.
Шеф, я не хотел предавать вас.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'I already love you so much as it is...' Chef Viktor addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'very'. Vika answers right away.
'Kostyan, save me right now!' The grammar packs 'Kostyan' and 'me' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I warned you not to come in here!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'warned'.
'Nastya, wait, we will talk about it later.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Nastya' and 'we'll have a talk' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Vika answers right away.
Шеф, шеф, шеф, это не поможет.
'Chef, Chef, Chef, chasing him will not help.' In Russian, the idea of 'chef' flows naturally into 'will help' without extra filler words.
'I know him very well.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'know' without extra filler words.
'It is better if you simply hear him out.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'better' before landing on 'him'. Vika answers right away.
'Chef, please, just talk to him for a minute.' The grammar packs 'chef' and 'have a word' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Alright, let us step outside for some air.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'let's' and finishing on 'air'.
Шеф, я не хотел предавать вас.
'Chef, I never wanted to betray you.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'chef', while 'you' completes the thought. Vika answers right away.
'I simply could not have acted any other way.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'otherwise' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'You made your own choice yourself.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'himself' in a few short words.
'And only after that come all the money issues.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'and', while 'grand' completes the thought. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Шеф, шеф, шеф, это не поможет.
Шеф, я не хотел предавать вас.
